notes.Cade Cunningham: Cunningham is probable with right knee soreness after skipping the second night of Wednesday's back-to-back, and Detroit is again without Jalen Duren and Duncan Robinson, so even more of the offense runs through him. He played 36 and 38 minutes in his last two games, and Detroit is a 7.5-point favorite, the only real threat to his fourth quarter.
notes.Shai Gilgeous-Alexander: Oklahoma City is still without Chet Holmgren, Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace, and Alex Caruso is questionable, so Gilgeous-Alexander carries the scoring load; he played 36 minutes Wednesday. New Orleans is down Dejounte Murray and Bennedict Mathurin, which explains the 11.5-point spread and the blowout risk to his minutes.
notes.Scottie Barnes: Barnes sat Wednesday with a groin issue but is not on Toronto's injury report tonight. With RJ Barrett out at least two weeks (hamstring), Collin Murray-Boyles in the concussion protocol and Kawhi Leonard out, he is the center of the offense; he played 36 and 34 minutes in his last two games.
notes.Jalen Johnson: With CJ McCollum out and Kingston Flemings questionable (lumbar strain), Johnson handles a big share of Atlanta's ball handling, which is why he has two triple-doubles in his last three games. Charlotte is missing Kon Knueppel, Dennis Schroder, Grayson Allen and Grant Williams.
notes.Donovan Mitchell: Evan Mobley is out (left great toe sprain, not back before Nov. 29) and Jaylon Tyson is out, so Mitchell is carrying Cleveland's offense; he scored 39 and 34 in 36 and 35 minutes in the last two games without Mobley. Indiana is without Tyrese Haliburton, and the 232.5 total is one of the highest on the slate.
notes.Royce O'Neale: Charlotte is without Grayson Allen (concussion protocol), Dennis Schroder, Kon Knueppel and Grant Williams. The last time Allen sat, Tuesday, O'Neale played 34 minutes off the bench after 19 to 22 in his previous games.
notes.Corey Kispert: CJ McCollum is out, but Atlanta's wing minutes keep rotating among Kispert, Luguentz Dort and Aaron Wiggins, and Kispert has played only 16 and 17 minutes in his last two games. He is a cheap shooter with a thin floor.
notes.Sion James: Charlotte is down Kon Knueppel, Dennis Schroder, Grayson Allen and Grant Williams, the player who started over him Tuesday. James has played 30 to 35 minutes in each of his last three games, though his value comes from steals, assists and rebounds more than scoring.
notes.Tre Jones: Caleb Wilson is out again, which has opened bench minutes for Jones, but they have swung from 24 and 23 down to 16 on Wednesday. Washington-Chicago has the highest total on the slate (239.5), which helps if he gets back to the mid-20s.
notes.Isaiah Joe: Detroit is without Duncan Robinson (left quadriceps strain) and Jalen Duren, which leaves shooting minutes on the wing. Joe played 16 minutes off the bench Wednesday in his return, so the role is still small.
notes.Luguentz Dort: Dort played 31 minutes Wednesday with CJ McCollum and Kingston Flemings out, after 20 and 18 in his previous two games. McCollum is out again and Flemings is questionable, so his minutes depend on Flemings.
Oubre has started Indiana's last four games, playing 29 to 34 minutes before 23 on Wednesday. Tyrese Haliburton is out again and Andrew Nembhard is questionable, and Indiana-Cleveland carries a 232.5 total.
notes.Jamison Battle: Battle started and played 33 minutes Wednesday with RJ Barrett, Scottie Barnes and Collin Murray-Boyles out. Barnes is back tonight, and the last time Barnes returned, Battle played only eight minutes, so his role depends on Barrett and Murray-Boyles staying out.
notes.Mario Hezonja: Hezonja started and played 28 minutes Wednesday with Peyton Watson out, and he is expected to start again if Watson (questionable, low back bruise) sits. Evan Mobley is also out, so the frontcourt minutes are open.
notes.Peyton Watson: Watson is questionable with a low back bruise from a hard fall Monday and missed Wednesday's game. If he plays he returns to Cleveland's starting five; if not, Mario Hezonja starts.
notes.Quenton Jackson: Jackson has started at point guard the last two games with Tyrese Haliburton and Andrew Nembhard out, playing 30 and 22 minutes. Nembhard is questionable tonight, and Rick Carlisle said his absence should not be long, so Jackson's start depends on that decision.
notes.Andrew Nembhard: Nembhard is questionable with a left hip sprain after missing two games, and Rick Carlisle said the absence should not be long. With Tyrese Haliburton out, he would take back the lead guard job from Quenton Jackson if he plays.
notes.Alperen Sengun: Sengun is questionable at Denver with an eye injury from Wednesday's game, and Clint Capela is already out and Steven Adams is questionable, so Houston could be very thin at center if he sits.
notes.Trey Murphy III: Murphy is questionable at Oklahoma City with a knee injury after missing six games. New Orleans is also without Dejounte Murray and Bennedict Mathurin, so he would step into a big role if cleared.
notes.Austin Reaves: Reaves is out against Sacramento, his fourth straight missed game, with a heel bruise and bone bruise; JJ Redick said there is nothing structural beyond the bruise.
